subject: Proof-of-Value run: evaluation sprint, owners & week-1 checkpoints
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: elena.ruiz@greenbridge.health, tom.hsu@greenbridge.health
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proof-of-Value run: evaluation sprint, owners & week-1 checkpoints

Hi Elena / Tom —

Great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed sprint structure to keep momentum while Greenbridge evaluates a live integration. My goal: make the first two weeks lightweight and measurable so you can sign off quickly.

Summary of what we heard from you:
- Primary goal: reduce triage time for clinical notes search by 40% (speed + precision).
- Success signals: median query latency under 600ms for the test set; Precision@10 >= 85% on the shared benchmark; no regressions on PHI-redaction checks.
- Data setup: you will provide a 10k-record sample export + mapping doc.
- Procurement: you flagged a standard SOW review and an initial PO for sandbox compute.

Proposed 2-week evaluation sprint (lightweight):
Week 0 (this week) — Kickoff + data handoff
- Action: Greenbridge delivers dataset & mapping (owner: Elena) — due EOD Thursday
- Action: Redwood uploads dataset to private sandbox and runs initial ingest (owner: marcus) — ETA Fri

Week 1 — Baseline runs & quick iterations
- Action: Run canonical queries, capture latency/precision baseline (owner: marcus) — target Wed
- Action: Implement 1st optimization pass (batching + KV cache config), rerun metrics (owner: marcus) — target Fri

Week 2 — Validation & signoff
- Action: Joint review of metrics vs success criteria, decision to proceed to pilot license (owners: Elena + vanessa) — target next Tue

Attachments: I attached a suggested success-criteria workbook and a draft SOW for procurement to review. Please let me know if any of the metrics above are off.

Next steps for this thread: can you confirm the dataset delivery date and whether procurement needs additional vendor paperwork before we spin up the sandbox?

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachments: POV_success_criteria_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Draft_Greenbridge_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: elena.ruiz@greenbridge.health
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.hsu@greenbridge.health, procurement@greenbridge.health
Date: 2027-04-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proof-of-Value run: evaluation sprint, owners & week-1 checkpoints

Vanessa — thanks for the recap and the clear sprint outline. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Dataset timing: we can deliver the 10k export by Thursday EOD PST. I will send a secure link to Marcus when it's ready.
2) Success criteria: the latency and Precision@10 targets look OK; can we add a requirement for model output stability (no more than 5% variance on repeated runs for the same seed)? That matters for clinical reproducibility.
3) Procurement note: procurement asked if you can provide our standard vendor form and a redline-friendly SOW (PDF). They also want an estimated monthly cost for a 3-month sandbox window.

I'll follow up with the dataset link when it's available. Tom — looping you to confirm PO timing.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Clinical Informatics
Greenbridge Health
elena.ruiz@greenbridge.health | +1 (212) 555-4488

Hi Elena — thanks for confirming the Thursday delivery. A couple of operational notes from the engineering side: 

- Format: prefer a single compressed CSV + schema mapping (fields: note_id, timestamp, author_role, raw_text, redaction_flags). If you have PHI-sensitive fields, we'll keep them in a locked sandbox with KMS; no data leaves the sandbox.
- Stability metric: we can add the repeatability check (<=5% variance) into the workbook; I'll update the POV_success_criteria_v1.xlsx and reattach here.
- Sandbox sizing: for a short 3-month evaluation (10k records + iterative runs) I estimate a cost ballpark of $1,800/mo for reserved sandbox capacity — feel free to treat as a config placeholder while procurement gets PO numbers.

I'll run an ingest test as soon as the link is live and post the job ID + logs to this thread.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, procurement@greenbridge.health
Date: 2027-04-10T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proof-of-Value run: evaluation sprint, owners & week-1 checkpoints — weekly status & quick asks

Hi all — week-1 nudge and short status: 

Status highlights
- Dataset: Elena shared the secure link yesterday; Marcus started ingest tests and reported a clean schema (job ID: ingest-GB-449).
- Baseline: initial latency runs completed against the sample; median latency currently ~720ms (unoptimized) and Precision@10 at 80%.
- Next: Marcus will apply caching/batching and push a tuned run Thursday morning.

Quick asks to keep the sprint tight:
1) Procurement: can procurement confirm if Greenbridge needs an addendum or specific insurance language? If so, please send the doc to monica.patel@redwoodinference.com.
2) Acceptance metric: Elena — confirm we should treat Precision@10 >= 85% and median latency < 600ms as the primary pass/fail for Week 2 signoff (we added stability <=5% as a gating metric as well).
3) PO timing: Tom — any updates on the tentative PO date? A sandbox PO helps us keep reserved instances in place.

I attached the updated success-criteria workbook and the SOW draft again for convenience. If everyone can reply with the procurement note and acceptance confirmation by EOD Friday, we'll stick to the Week 2 review target.

Thanks — short and focused this week.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
